message: Great job everyone on the TeamUnity prep! I think the activities planned will really help with our team cohesion.
I've heard that TeamUnity workshops can be quite intense. Hope it helps sort out the tension between some of our team members, especially with the ongoing friction between Mark and Julia.
Can anyone share the last year's TeamUnity workshop docs? I want to see what kind of activities they had us do. Particularly interested in how they addressed conflicts within teams.

Remember how Tom and Jessica were paired up for that trust fall exercise in the last TeamUnity workshop? 😂 There's been some talk they might be more than just coworkers. A major problem is there interaction seems to affect he team morale in a negative way, shh...

The TeamUnity workshop is coming up, and I think it's a good time to reflect on our recent success with the complex audit. It really showed our strength as a team, despite some underlying tensions that I hope we can openly discuss and resolve.
